title: Access Workbench: Member assignment & permission boundary flows
creator: Lena Chen
description: Problem statement: As part of RBAC v2 we need a unified Console surface that lets tenant admins create role bindings, apply permission boundaries, map SAML/SCIM groups, and assign members with clear visibility into effective permissions and audit provenance. Goals: reduce misconfiguration by showing access previews, provide efficient bulk assignment with conflict detection, surface audit metadata (who/granted/why) inline, and support delegated admin flows. This ticket covers the design for the member assignment and permission boundaries ("workbench") UI, interaction states, microcopy, and accessibility considerations. Deliverables: high-fidelity mocks for single-assign and bulk-assign flows, a compact assignment drawer, access preview modal, audit breadcrumbs component, accessibility spec, and handoff tokens for engineering.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Lena Chen: Initial draft UX flow uploaded to Figma. Included three patterns: inline role dropdown, modal-based assignment, and assignment drawer. Recommended drawer for quick context-switching and audit visibility.

2026-03-03 - PM feedback (Diego Martinez): Prefer drawer for speed, but need explicit confirmation for any assignment that elevates privileges (safety guard). Add SAML group mapping UX and a notice when external group grants will be created.

2026-03-05 - Eng review (Maya Singh): Feasibility notes: server will return 'effective_policy' for preview; recommend we limit preview to first 500 resources to bound latency. Also call out that bulk import should be idempotent and return a CSV of failures.

2026-03-06 - Security (Omar Haddad): Must include immutable audit reference (audit_id) on any assignment event and expose a link to the audit log. Security requests a copy of microcopy for legal review.

2026-03-08 - Lena Chen: Updated mocks: added Access Preview panel showing aggregated permissions with explainability hints (e.g., 'granted via role: billing-operator'), conflict resolution banner for overlapping bindings, and a 'safe-assign' checkbox for high-risk grants that requires 2FA confirmation when SSO enforcement is on.

2026-03-09 - UX review (Priya Rao): Suggested improvements: compress member list rows, add keyboard shortcuts for repeated assigns, and surface last-active timestamp next to members. Also recommend color-safe indicators for effective permission levels (None/Read/Write/Admin).

2026-03-10 - Asha Patel: Merged copy into PRD and created GitHub draft PR for frontend components. Requesting design handoff and engineering estimates for implementation. Marked security_review_required = true.
2026-03-10 - Blocker (Asha Patel): Backend needs RBAC/permission-sim API endpoint (ENG-22407) to support access previews; blocked until API contract finalizes. Added dependency on ENG-22407.

2026-03-10 - Next steps (Lena Chen): Prepare handoff package: component specs, edge-state screenshots, accessibility checklist (aria labels, focus management), and copy deck. Schedule 1:1 with ENG and SEC to unblock.
Design notes: show provenance for each permission (role vs group vs direct), allow revocation history preview, and include rate-limiting guidance for bulk operations in the UI to avoid timeouts.
